requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide `xnl-vfs-editor` as a reusable Vue3 component package exporting a `VfsEditor` component (plus composables and types), decoupled from any application shell, consumable by downstream apps including a sibling demo.

case.when: The consumer renders `<VfsEditor>` within its own app.
case.then: The component SHALL render and operate without depending on the original app's router/views/pinia bootstrap.

case.given: Heavy UI deps (vue, element-plus, ag-grid-*, monaco) are declared as peerDependencies.
case.when: The package is built in lib mode.
case.then: Those deps SHALL be externalized (provided by the consumer), not bundled into the library output.

requirement.statement: The component's file system SHALL be sourced from `xnl-vfs` (`VirtualFileSystem` + `IndexedDbVfsPersistence`), with no bespoke vfs store or bespoke IndexedDB schema.

case.given: The editor manages a directory tree and file contents.
case.when: It reads or writes the tree/content.
case.then: All reads/writes SHALL go through xnl-vfs APIs (readdir/readFile/writeFile/mkdir/rename/unlink/rmdir), and there SHALL be no bespoke `vfsStore`/`db/indexedDb` data source.
IndexedDB SHALL be used only as the xnl-vfs persistence backend (`IndexedDbVfsPersistence`), not as a competing data source.

requirement.statement: Node layout (positions, collapsed, zoom) SHALL be stored in the file's vfs `extend` metadata, keyed by STABLE XNL node id (never the render-layer ulid), and SHALL NEVER be written back into the XNL business content (decision D1).

case.given: A user moves or collapses a node.
case.then: It SHALL be written to vfs `extend` keyed by the node's stable XNL id, and the XNL content blob SHALL remain unchanged.

case.given: Transient session UI state (selection, form expand, scroll).
case.then: It SHALL be held in memory (depa/component state) and SHALL NOT be persisted to vfs or committed.

requirement.statement: History SHALL use `xnl-vcs`: an explicit save creates a commit, while edits apply to the working tree immediately and a debounced autosave persists the uncommitted working tree (decision D2).

case.given: The user triggers an explicit save.
case.then: The system SHALL create one `xnl-vcs` commit capturing the working tree snapshot.
Edits SHALL apply to the working tree immediately and a debounced autosave SHALL persist the uncommitted working tree (persistWorkspace) without creating history commits.

requirement.statement: A runnable demo app at `demo/vfs-editor` SHALL consume the `xnl-vfs-editor` component and provide a working VFS editor (create/edit/save/export).

case.given: The demo app is built and started.
case.then: It SHALL render the `xnl-vfs-editor` component wired to concrete xnl-vfs/xnl-vcs instances and support create/edit/save(commit)/export end to end.
